adaptations.purpose: File-first diversification: after the strongest anchors, take one item per file before a second item from any file.
adaptations.fehmAdapter: src/context-selection.ts#diversifyHits maps Fehm RetrievalHit[] to candidates (group = file path, singleton group for path-less nodes), keeps a prefix of strong anchors (Fehm addition) and dedupes node ids.

notUsed: Graft CLI, hooks, agent integrations, daemon, graph engine, ranking (fuse.ts/graphrank.ts), viewer.
